recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work should avoid adding a new core authoritativeurl element or reasserting Meta.source as the sole ValueSet authoritative-source mechanism; ValueSet/artifact authoritative-source maintenance belongs with Extension Pack extensions while the core CanonicalResource.url and Meta.source guidance remains appropriate.
issue_request: FHIR-17232 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core many metadata resources. It requested a mutable resource.authoritativeurl element for authoritative source-of-truth location changes, but the accepted resolution used Resource.meta.source and requested matching guidance on MetadataResource.url, Meta.source, and terminology/registry descriptions.
initial_application: Commit 8d91ecdf35396eebd61bcd65853d1384a559d470, "GF#17232 - notes about meta.source and canonical url", applied the requested guidance to the historical MetadataResource and Meta spreadsheet sources. The current source has refactored MetadataResource.url through CanonicalResource.url, with source/fhir.ini actively mapping MetadataResource.url to CanonicalResource.url.
additional_context: Current CanonicalResource.url guidance says the URL should be a literal address for an authoritative instance and points to meta.source when a resource can no longer be found at the stated URL but the URL cannot change. Current Meta.source guidance says it can identify where the current master source of a canonical resource is found when no longer hosted at the canonical URL. Later FHIR-17570 narrowed the ValueSet-specific authoritative-source use case to an extension, now in the FHIR Extension Pack, and later FHIR-49878 clarified Meta.source wording while preserving the canonical current-master-source note.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already carries the FHIR-17232 canonical URL and Meta.source guidance in the refactored CanonicalResource/Meta locations, and adding new terminology ValueSet prose that directs users to Resource.meta.source would conflict with the later FHIR-17570 ValueSet-specific resolution.

related_jiras.note: Vocab determined that Resource.meta.source was insufficient for the ValueSet-specific authoritative-source use case and added valueset-authoritativeSource, now outside core.
FHIR-I clarified Meta.source as a data source and preserved the canonical current-master-source note.
